promptHints: Draft the keyed acceptance criteria for the request: WHAT must be true when it ships, not how to build it. One line per criterion, `- **R-<prefix>-<n>** <criterion>`, at most 6 per perspective.

inputs.directive:

The person asked for changes to the requirements. Write the next draft from scratch, addressing EVERY point in the feedback below. Keep every criterion id the feedback does not ask you to drop.
